# The system classes that a Backports proxy shadows, one per line: "shadow <class> <proxy> <symbol>".
# A class is shadowed when the iOS 6.0 release has it, its Revenant proxy implements members of it, and the Backports library lowers
# none onto the system class itself: an import that binds to the system class gets a class without those members. A consumer rebinds such an import
# to the Backports exporter of <symbol>. The proxy's members are in lowered-members.txt under <proxy>.
# Generated by frameworks/Backports/tools/shadowed_classes.lua from the proxy sources, lowered-members.txt and device-members.txt; do not edit. The test
# frameworks/Backports/tests/lowered_members_test.lua fails when this file no longer matches the sources.
shadow CASpringAnimation RevenantCASpringAnimation _OBJC_CLASS_$_CASpringAnimation
